prompt: Send a Slack DM to Robert in our #engineering channel, asking for an ETA update on the multi-GPU streaming rewrite of circuit-tracer.
binding_note: The route runs USER→WORKSPACE_MEMBERSHIP→WORKSPACE→CONVERSATION: the target is a workspace member who is a member of the #engineering conversation. Two workspace members named Robert are both members of #engineering — Robert Walsh (who has posted there on an unrelated topic) and Robert Chen (who also posted there, including the reply asking about the circuit-tracer rewrite's ETA) — so plain channel membership under the first name 'Robert' does not resolve to one person. The rewrite/ETA phrase in the request is the DM's content, not an added identifying constraint restricting membership to that specific thread.
